# Tables for Study A v2 (generated by `src/analyze_v2.py`; do not edit by hand)

Pilot cost $P=1280$ ratings is charged to every pilot-using selector. Gains are loss(second) minus loss(first); positive means the first selector is better. Intervals and $p$ are from the replication $\times$ test-item two-way bootstrap (10,000 draws); Holm adjusts across the 20 cells within a family.
